steps.note: +init rolls REF + 1d10 for initiative. All participants roll; the GM tracks turn order.

steps.label: roll initiative
display initiative order

steps.note: +attack rolls the appropriate weapon skill + REF vs the target's DV. Specify target by name.

steps.label: standard ranged attack
melee attack (Brawling or Melee Weapon)
aimed shot — -8 to attack, +1 damage on hit (errata)
autofire SMG at medium range — DV from errata p.173 table

steps.note: Called shots take -8 to attack. Head shots double damage AFTER armor (CPR Core p.180). Limb/eye shots apply a location effect on any hit.

steps.label: head shot — head SP, ×2 damage after armor
called shot to arm — disarm on hit
called shot to leg — -4 MOVE on hit
called shot to eye — blind on hit
suppressive fire — pin everyone in the area (WILL DV15)

steps.note: +ammo lists your loadout and lets you switch the loaded ammo for each weapon. AP halves SP and halves damage vs Light/Medium armor. Expansive doubles damage vs unarmored but cannot harm armored targets. Rubber routes damage to the stun pool instead of HP. Smart ammo requires a Smartgun Link cyberware.

steps.label: view current ammo loadout
list every ammo type and effect
load AP rounds — halves SP, halves damage vs Light/Medium
attack with AP loaded — note the [ARMOR_PIERCING] tag on output
swap to rubber — non-lethal, routes to stun pool
rubber attack — damage hits STUN, [KO] when stun ≤ 0
swap to incendiary — 1 ongoing burn damage on hit
incendiary attack — target gains a burn effect

steps.note: +effects shows active on-hit conditions (burn, poison, sleep, EMP, biotoxin). Effects tick on the target's +pass action and apply damage / save DV as appropriate. /snuff puts out fires.

steps.label: list any active ammo effects on you
spend an action to extinguish a burn effect

steps.note: +throw <grenade>=<target> lobs a grenade. AoE defaults to AP (errata p.345). Damage grenades roll Xd6 vs every target in the area; save-based grenades (flashbang/teargas/sonic) trigger a save instead of damage.

steps.label: frag — 6d6 AP vs everyone in the room
flashbang — DV15 BODY save or blinded
smoke — creates a smoke zone, -4 to targeted actions

steps.note: Brawl moves use Brawling skill. Most are opposed rolls (attacker vs defender). Grab must succeed before throw/pin/choke.

steps.label: attempt to grab — Brawling vs Brawling
throw a grabbed target — 1d6 damage + prone
pin a grabbed target — immobilized until escape
choke a grabbed target — STUN damage, possible unconscious
disarm — no grab needed, BOD+Brawling vs defender
pass your turn this round

steps.note: +wound applies direct damage. Admin/medtech use. Player-facing wound tracking is handled by attack resolution.

steps.label: apply 15 damage to V (admin)
roll a critical injury to body (2d6 on table)
roll a critical injury to head

steps.note: +stabilize <target> stabilizes a Mortally Wounded character (requires First Aid roll). +deathsave is used automatically when at 0 HP — BODY vs threshold.

steps.label: apply first aid to a target character — TECH+first_aid vs DV15 for 1d6 HP
apply 10 healing to self (admin/medtech direct HP grant)
apply 10 healing to another character (admin only)
use a Speedheal stim — restore 10 HP instantly
view the combat log for this encounter
end the combat encounter (admin)
